[FACT] User is looking for new vegan recipes to try out.  
[FACT] User has been experimenting with different plant-based milks lately.  
[PREFERENCE] User's favorite plant-based milk is oat milk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Vegan comfort food is the best!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended vegan comfort food recipes include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Vegan Mac 'n Cheese: Use non-dairy milk and vegan cheese alternative.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Lentil Shepherd's Pie: Made with lentils, sautéed veggies, and mashed potatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Vegan Chick'n Parmesan: Breaded tofu or tempeh with marinara sauce and vegan mozzarella.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Creamy Tomato Soup: Blend canned tomatoes with sautéed onions, garlic, and plant-based milk.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Stuffed Bell Peppers: Fill with quinoa, black beans, and vegan ground "beef."  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Vegan Chicken Tenders: Marinate tofu or tempeh, bread, and bake.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Roasted Vegetable Lasagna: Layers of roasted veggies, noodles, and dairy-free cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Vegan Meatball Subs: Use plant-based meat substitute or homemade meatballs.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Creamy Broccoli Pasta Bake: Made with pasta, broccoli, and creamy sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Vegan Apple Crisp: A warm dessert using oat milk for the crumble topping.  
[EVENT] User is planning to attend a vegan cooking class next week.  
[CHANGE] User has been trying out new recipes and ingredients almost daily since switching to a veggie lifestyle about three months ago.
